sentence: Through the mist-laden valley the solitary figure wandered aimlessly
explanation: Anteposición literaria (fronting): el sintagma preposicional <Through the mist-laden valley> se coloca antes del sujeto.

sentence: So profound was her grief that words failed to capture its depth
hint: So + adjective + was + subject + that clause
explanation: Inversión literaria con <So ... that> para dar énfasis dramático.

sentence: Beneath the ancient oak tree lay the remnants of a forgotten civilisation
explanation: Inversión literaria: <Beneath ... lay the remnants> coloca el escenario antes del sujeto.

sentence: Not until the final chapter does the true nature of the protagonist emerge
hint: Not until + noun phrase + auxiliary + subject + verb
explanation: La inversión literaria después de <Not until> crea suspenso.

sentence: In the gathering twilight the old house seemed to breathe with memories
explanation: Anteposición literaria: la frase temporal crea atmósfera antes de la cláusula principal.

sentence: Gone were the days of innocence replaced by a weary resignation
hint: Past participle + were + subject + past participle phrase
explanation: Inversión literaria: <Gone were the days> es una construcción literaria clásica.

sentence: With each passing season the garden surrendered another fragment of its former glory
explanation: Anteposición literaria: <With each passing season> establece el marco temporal.

sentence: Seldom had the village witnessed such an extraordinary display of courage
hint: Seldom + had + subject + past participle + object
explanation: Inversión literaria después de <Seldom> para dar énfasis dramático.

sentence: Along the winding river path she walked lost in contemplation of the past
hint: Prepositional phrase + subject + verb + participial phrase
explanation: Anteposición literaria: la frase de escenario precede a la acción del personaje.

sentence: Such was the power of his words that even his adversaries were moved to silence
explanation: Inversión literaria con <Such ... that> para dar énfasis retórico.

sentence: From the ashes of despair there arose an unexpected and luminous hope
explanation: Inversión literaria: <there arose> con el sintagma preposicional antepuesto.

sentence: Never again would the world seem quite so simple or so full of promise
hint: Never again + would + subject + verb + complement
explanation: Inversión literaria después de <Never again> para un tono elegíaco.

sentence: Deep within the forest something ancient and watchful stirred
explanation: Anteposición literaria: el escenario precede al sujeto para crear atmósfera de suspenso.

sentence: Little did she suspect that the letter would change everything
hint: Little + did + subject + verb + that clause
explanation: Inversión con <Little> al inicio: apenas sospechaba, dando un tono de presagio.

sentence: Only when the storm subsided did the villagers dare to leave their homes
explanation: <Only when> antepuesto exige inversión del auxiliar en la cláusula principal.

sentence: Across the desolate moor the wind carried a mournful, distant cry
explanation: Anteposición literaria del sintagma de lugar para establecer la escena.

sentence: Rarely does one encounter such quiet, unassuming courage
explanation: Inversión con <Rarely> al inicio para dar énfasis literario.

sentence: Only later would she understand the true weight of that decision
hint: Only later + would + subject + verb + object
explanation: <Only later> antepuesto provoca inversión, creando un efecto de premonición narrativa.

sentence: Amid the ruins of the old cathedral time itself seemed to falter
explanation: <Amid> es una preposición formal/literaria que significa 'en medio de'.

sentence: Down the cobbled street echoed the fading footsteps of a stranger
explanation: Inversión literaria: el verbo <echoed> precede al sujeto tras el sintagma de lugar.
